newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures retreat from peak on US selling.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures retreat from peak on US selling.

text.p: IPE Brent futures dipped in on Tuesday after NYMEX crude futures failed to sustain new post-Gulf War highs achieved on ACCESS once the New York pit opened, traders said.
The November Brent contract, due to expire at the close of Wednesday's session, was trading at 14 cents off $24.72 a barrel at 1527 GMT, while the December contract stood 13 cents down at $24.25.
"The dip on NYMEX has taken the wind out of Brent here," one trader said. "Also, there's a fair amount of length in the market which will put a cap on the market for the moment."
